summary: Agassi Sports Entertainment Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the entry into Subscription Agreements with accredited investors for a private placement of 235,000 restricted common shares at $5.00 per share, raising $1,175,000. Concurrently, the Company entered into a Registration Rights Agreement obligating it to file a resale registration statement within 45 days and maintain effectiveness for up to three years. Failure to file triggers escalating liquidated damages of 5% of held shares per 30-day period, capped at an aggregate limit. This capital-raising event, while material, is not an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other typical special situation; it represents an ordinary equity financing with registration rights. Watch for the registration statement filing deadline in early July 2026 and potential dilution from penalty shares.
